item.description: Mastiii 4 will stream on ZEE5 after its theatrical run, giving fans an easier way to watch the adult comedy without cuts. The OTT premiere is scheduled for 16 January 2026, making it one of the first major adult comedies to release in the new year.

item.title: 120 Bahadur premiere: Rekha shines in sindoor, Saba–Sonal twin; Farhan–Ranveer-Hrithik fashion on point
item.description: A star-studded screening of 120 Bahadur was held in Mumbai on November 19. The guest list saw prominent B-town celebs, including Hrithik Roshan, Ranveer Singh, Rekha, Waheeda Rehman, Tiger Shroff and others in attendance.

item.title: SIA raids Kashmir Times office; shocking recovery of arms, ammunition
item.description: In a dramatic security operation, the State Investigation Agency (SIA) raided the Kashmir Times head office in Jammu, recovering a revolver, ammunition, grenade safety levers, and multiple digital devices.

item.title: Faridabad bomb plot and South India ricin conspiracy expose ISI
item.description: The ISI has picked up on this issue and is trying to convey the message through groups such as the ISKP that South India has to be separated from North India. Just like the Faridabad module, the ISKP operative Saiyed was being handled by a person based out of Afghanistan. This is once again a ploy of the ISI to avoid scrutiny, and hence, it ensured handlers from Afghanistan carried out all operations.
